catalog_metadata.description: Pluggable vendor-neutral hardware isolation catalog defining four industry-standard OT Data Diode and Controlled Unidirectional/Bi-Directional Gateway archetypes, deterministic sizing ceilings, and Green/Amber/Red protocol cutover rules.
catalog_metadata.custom_sku_override_note: To adapt ConduitAI for commercial post-assessment quoting, point HARDWARE_CATALOG_PATH to a private_vendor_catalog.json adhering to this schema.

selection_priority_order: 1. Enforce directionality: Always prefer pure unidirectional hardware isolation (ARCH_A, ARCH_B, ARCH_C) for SL-4 air-gap enforcement unless verified operational closed-loop MES/EMS setpoints strictly require ARCH_D.

2. Match physical cabinet constraints from SAM 3.1 inspection: Do not place 1U_19INCH_RACK appliances into DIN-rail-only field enclosures unless a rack shelf/cabinet upgrade is explicitly added to the BoM.
3. Enforce hard protocol, PLC count, camera stream, VLAN trunk, and 1.25x peak Mbps headroom ceilings; split across multiple units or step up to ARCH_C when multi-VLAN aggregation is required.

archetypes.name: Industrial Field Protocol Diode
archetypes.hardware_isolation_layer: Layer 1/2 Physical Unidirectional Hardware Barrier (OS-Less FPGA / Optical Coupling)

physical_requirements.power_supply: Dual Redundant 12-48V DC Industrial Terminal Block

proxy_architecture.tx_inner_subsystem: OS-less/embedded OT-side master poller & UDP listener; actively polls up to 32 Modbus TCP, IEC-104, or DNP3 slave PLCs/RTUs locally on the OT LAN and pushes deterministic register snapshots across the one-way hardware barrier.
proxy_architecture.rx_outer_subsystem: IT/DMZ-side protocol replica server; maintains a real-time read-only state table so upstream SCADA, EMS, or Historians poll the RX Virtual IP normally with zero packets ever crossing back into OT.

target_environments: Water & wastewater remote pump station PLC skids
Single-cell manufacturing lines without 19-inch server racks

archetypes.name: Edge Video & IoT Unidirectional Proxy Diode
archetypes.hardware_isolation_layer: Layer 1/2 Physical Unidirectional Hardware Barrier with High-Speed RTP/UDP Frame Splicer

physical_requirements.power_supply: 12-48V DC Terminal or 100-240V AC Industrial Adapter

proxy_architecture.tx_inner_subsystem: Initiates RTSP/ONVIF stream sessions, BACnet COV subscriptions, and local MQTT broker ingestion strictly inside the isolated camera/BMS zone; strips TCP/IP framing and streams raw H.264/H.265/telemetry frames one-way.
proxy_architecture.rx_outer_subsystem: Reconstructs virtual RTSP/ONVIF camera endpoints and publishes MQTT/HTTPS/Syslog feeds toward corporate VMS/NVR, AI video analytics, and smart-building cloud platforms.

target_environments: IP CCTV & perimeter surveillance networks isolating vulnerable camera firmware
Smart commercial buildings & hospital BMS/HVAC BACnet telemetry

archetypes.name: 1U Enterprise Rackmount Protocol-Breaking Diode
archetypes.hardware_isolation_layer: Dual Independent TX/RX Proxy CPUs Separated by OS-Less Layer 1/2 Physical Unidirectional Hardware Barrier

physical_requirements.enclosure_rating: IP20 Standard 19-Inch 1U Control Room / Data Center Chassis

proxy_architecture.tx_inner_subsystem: Dedicated OT-side proxy complex supporting up to 16 VLAN sub-interfaces; terminates OT TCP sessions locally, polls OPC-UA/Modbus servers, ingests SFTP/SQL Historian batches, strips all L2/L3/L4 headers, and transmits pure serialized payloads across the physical air-gap.
proxy_architecture.rx_outer_subsystem: Dedicated IT/DMZ-side proxy complex; re-originates independent TCP/TLS sessions to enterprise PI/SQL Historians, cloud data lakes, SIEM collectors, and SFTP file repositories.

target_environments: Plant-wide Purdue Level 3 to Level 3.5/4 IT/OT DMZ boundaries
Multi-VLAN automotive, pharmaceutical, semiconductor & refinery sites
Enterprise OSIsoft PI / SQL Historian replication & SFTP batch file relays

archetypes.name: Dual-Stage Controlled Bi-Directional Gateway
archetypes.hardware_isolation_layer: Tandem Dual-Isolation Non-Routable Hardware Pathways with Hardware-Enforced OT Session Lock

physical_requirements.enclosure_rating: IP20 Standard 19-Inch 1U Control Room / Data Center Chassis

proxy_architecture.tx_inner_subsystem: Enforces strict session asymmetry: ALL TCP SYN connections MUST originate from the secure OT side. Polls the DMZ staging buffer on a deterministic schedule and validates reverse payloads against cryptographic signatures, XSD/JSON schemas, and Modbus/IEC-104 function-code/register-range whitelists.
proxy_architecture.rx_outer_subsystem: Non-routable DMZ staging proxy; receives signed MES batch recipes or EMS dispatch setpoints into an isolated passive holding queue while streaming high-speed 1 Gbps OT telemetry outward.

permitted_reverse_use_cases: Signed MES-to-SCADA production batch recipe download
Utility EMS Automatic Generation Control (AGC) / load-shedding setpoint dispatch
OT-initiated pull of vendor-signed antivirus/patch bundles from DMZ staging
Authenticated request-response query where local replica caching is infeasible
archetypes.max_iec62443_sl: SL-3 (SL-4 with cryptographic payload signing & dual hardware guard)
target_environments: Automated discrete/batch manufacturing requiring live ERP/MES order dispatch
Bulk Electric System (BES) substations under active EMS AGC closed-loop control

GREEN.summary: Flows initiated from the OT zone pushing outward to IT/DMZ, or streaming protocols natively handled by diode TX->RX proxies with zero inbound IT changes.

protocols.proxy_behavior: TX listens on UDP 514 inside OT VLAN; forwards datagrams across Layer 1/2 barrier; RX spoofs or relays UDP/TLS Syslog to IT SIEM.
Diode TX initiates RTSP PLAY locally to OT cameras; streams raw RTP video frames across hardware barrier; Diode RX exposes virtual RTSP stream to corporate VMS/NVR.
Diode TX queries ONVIF media profile locally and pushes continuous media stream to RX virtual camera endpoint (blocks PTZ write-back).
OT devices publish to Diode TX embedded MQTT broker; TX serializes topic payloads one-way; RX publishes to IT/Cloud MQTT broker.
OT host uploads batch CSV/historian files to Diode TX SFTP dropbox; TX verifies file hash and streams bytes across hardware barrier; RX pushes via SFTP to IT landing server.
TX terminates outbound REST/Webhook POST payload inside OT and re-emits fresh HTTPS POST from RX to IT API gateway.
OT Historian pushes incremental row deltas/CDC logs into TX listener; RX replays deterministic INSERT/UPSERT batches into IT Replica DB.
OT alarm server sends outbound alert emails to TX SMTP relay; RX forwards to corporate mail gateway.
TX subscribes to local BACnet/IP Change-of-Value (COV) broadcasts and streams point telemetry one-way to RX BMS collector.

AMBER.tier_label: Inbound Poll — Requires Pull-to-Push Proxy Reversal
AMBER.summary: Flows where an IT/DMZ server currently initiates the TCP SYN inward to poll an OT PLC, RTU, OPC-UA server, or database for read-only telemetry, OR authorized closed-loop setpoint writes requiring controlled gateway evaluation.

protocols.remediation_pattern: Configure Diode TX Inner Proxy to poll the OT PLC (port 502) locally on the OT LAN at the required scan rate (e.g., 500ms-1000ms) and push register maps across the hardware barrier to the Diode RX Replica IP. Re-point the IT Historian to poll the Diode RX Virtual IP instead of the OT PLC IP.
Diode TX acts as local IEC 60870-5-104 controlling station polling substation RTUs/IEDs and streaming spontaneous/interrogated ASDUs one-way to Diode RX slave replica for SLDC/EMS ingestion.
Diode TX polls DNP3 outstations locally inside the substation ESP and mirrors unsolicited/polled point state to the Diode RX DNP3 outstation emulator.
Diode TX OPC-UA Client connects locally to the OT OPC-UA Server, subscribes to monitored node IDs, and mirrors the address space one-way to the Diode RX Shadow OPC-UA Server.
Replace inbound IT SQL SELECT queries with an OT-side scheduled CDC/query-push agent feeding Diode TX -> IT DMZ SQL Replica.

Pure one-way diodes block reverse writes. If verified operationally mandatory (MES recipe or utility AGC dispatch), deploy ARCH_D_BIDIRECTIONAL_GATEWAY with TCP SYN locked to OT side and strict register/schema whitelist; otherwise move recipe logic inside OT.

RED.tier_label: Protocol Blocker or Critical Security Violation
RED.summary: Legacy protocols using dynamic RPC ephemeral port negotiation that break across hardware proxies, stateful file-sharing protocols exploited by ransomware, or unauthorized interactive remote admin/write sessions from IT.

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: Microsoft DCOM RPC negotiates random dynamic high ports bidirectionally and requires mutual stateful COM callbacks that cannot traverse a non-routable hardware data diode.
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Deploy a lightweight local OPC-DA-to-OPC-UA Wrapper on the OT LAN adjacent to the legacy OPC server; convert DCOM tags to static single-port OPC-UA (TCP 4840) and feed into Diode TX Inner Proxy.

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: SMB requires chatter-heavy bidirectional locking/acknowledgments and is the #1 propagation vector for WannaCry/NotPetya/LockBit lateral movement into OT.
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Sever TCP 445/139 completely at the zone boundary. Replace shared drive mounts with a local OT directory watcher that pushes completed CSV/log files unidirectionally via SFTP (TCP 2222) across Diode TX -> RX.

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: Interactive remote desktop from Corporate IT into OT violates IEC 62443-3-3 SR 5.1/5.2 and NERC CIP-005-7 R2; impossible across unidirectional hardware.
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Physically sever inbound RDP via hardware diode. Require on-site engineering access or an out-of-band MFA jump host under explicit physical key-switch maintenance control.

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: Inbound interactive shell access from IT to OT switches/PLCs provides direct command-execution lateral movement.
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Physically sever inbound SSH at Layer 1/2 via hardware diode; confine CLI management strictly to an isolated OT Engineering Workstation (Purdue L3).

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: Unencrypted interactive terminal session exposing OT credentials and direct PLC/RTU manipulation.
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Physically sever inbound Telnet at Layer 1/2 via hardware diode and disable Telnet VTY lines on OT switches.

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: Interactive screen-sharing / shadow vendor remote access bypassing perimeter change control (e.g., Oldsmar water facility attack pattern).
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Physically sever via hardware diode; stream read-only HMI screen/process replicas outward via web/RTSP telemetry proxy if remote viewing is needed.

protocols.why_it_breaks_diode: Unverified IT subnet host sending physical actuation/register overwrite commands directly to Level 1 PLCs/RTUs.
protocols.prescribed_remediation: Block 100% physically by deploying unidirectional hardware isolation (ARCH_A or ARCH_C), rendering inbound packet injection physically impossible.
